# Manage all your farms, fields and crops in one place

The CropX system aggregates data from soil to sky and transforms it into useful information, helping
farmers monitor the health of fields and crops. The information is easy to access and provides a
holistic overview of field conditions.

[ Explore solution ][74]

# Make timely data-driven agronomic decisions

Insights and advice for performing irrigation, disease, nutrition and effluent management activities
help users minimize the use of inputs while maximizing yields. It’s so clear that you don’t even
need agronomic expertise to achieve great results.

[ Explore solution ][75]

## Connect all your IoT devices, sensors, and farm machines

The CropX system is a one-stop-shop for agronomic data, connecting from many sources into one
platform where it can be activated for the benefits of farms and the agricultural supply chain.  

[ Explore solution ][76]

## Track and report on your crop performance and farm practices

Tracking and reporting activities are key for transparency in the agricultural supply chain and
create opportunities for adding value. With a click of a button, the CropX system will compile data
on environmental events, resource use, and crop performance.

[ Explore solution ][77]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is CropX?

CropX is the **world’s leading digital farm management system** for precision agriculture, known for
its ease-of-use, comprehensive agronomic features, and powerful integrations. CropX products include
easy to install **sensors** (soil, rain gauge, weather station, ET, telemetry), complete farm
management **software** (FMS), and specialized **tools for dealers and agribusinesses** for managing
farm operations at scale. We are intentionally focused on **all things agronomy **– soil and plant
health, irrigation, disease, nutrition, weather, crop monitoring, and more.

### Who is it for?

CropX is a complete agronomy solution for **farmers, dealers, agronomic advisors and
agribusinesses** who are serious about yields, profits, efficiency, and sustainability. Unlike
others, our hardware and software is super easy to learn and use, has been in production for 10+
years, is trusted by 20,000+ users worldwide, operates in 70+ countries, and serves 100+ different
crop types. We think you’ll love it!

### How exactly does it work?

We continuously collect and analyze data from a variety of **in-field sensors** (such as soil
sensors, ET sensors, weather stations – both our own and third party), **satellites**, and **farm
machinery** (almost any brand)

We apply our proprietory, research-backed **agronomic models, data science, and** **AI** tailored to
your specific crop, field and weather conditions to track the past and predict the future of things
like water use, crop stress, disease risk, nitrate leaching, salinity levels, vegetative growth,
root and canopy development, and

# Manage all your farms, fields and crops in one place

The CropX system aggregates data from soil to sky and transforms it into useful information, helping
farmers monitor the health of fields and crops. The information is easy to access and provides a
holistic overview of field conditions.

[ Explore solution ][74]

# Make timely data-driven agronomic decisions

Insights and advice for performing irrigation, disease, nutrition and effluent management activities
help users minimize the use of inputs while maximizing yields. It’s so clear that you don’t even
need agronomic expertise to achieve great results.

[ Explore solution ][75]

## Connect all your IoT devices, sensors, and farm machines

The CropX system is a one-stop-shop for agronomic data, connecting from many sources into one
platform where it can be activated for the benefits of farms and the agricultural supply chain.  

[ Explore solution ][76]

## Track and report on your crop performance and farm practices

Tracking and reporting activities are key for transparency in the agricultural supply chain and
create opportunities for adding value. With a click of a button, the CropX system will compile data
on environmental events, resource use, and crop performance.

[ Explore solution ][77]

health, irrigation, disease, nutrition, weather, crop monitoring, and more.

goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,

developing a carbon-neutral company. An organic dairy expert and advocate for sustainable farming
practices, Jake offers expert insights into the opportunities for dairy farmers to not only meet
their sustainability goals but to improve performance and profitability. Jake shares insights on
various Neutral projects aimed at reducing greenhouse gases, including interior fermentation, manure
management, and transitioning to electric power. He also discusses the use of Agolin®, a
Carbon-Trust-certified essential oil blend added to cow feed. Despite the challenges, Jake remains
hopeful about the future of farming and the role of companies like Neutral in driving sustainable
change.

## Welcome to Aolan

Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2016, is one of the first high-tech

## Why Choose Us

[[Agricultura Drone, Crop Drone, Drone Power Sprayer - Aolan]][20]

Why Choose Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd?

In the fast-paced world of technology and innovation, it is crucial to choose a reliable and
experienced partner for all your agricultural technology needs. Aolan Drone Science and Technology
Co., Ltd is a pioneer in the field, established in 2016 as one of the first batch of high-tech
enterprises supported in China. With over 8 years of experience in agricultural technology
development and services, Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd is the ideal choice for
farmers and businesses looking to harness the power of drones and other advanced technologies.

One of the key reasons to choose Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd is our unwavering
commitment to innovation and quality. Our team of highly skilled engineers and agricultural experts
are constantly pushing the boundaries of technology to develop cutting-edge solutions that cater to
the specific needs of the farming industry. By staying at the forefront of technological
advancements, we ensure that our clients have access to the most advanced and efficient solutions
available in the market.

At Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd, we understand the unique challenges that farmers
face, be it pest management, crop monitoring, or irrigation management. Our solutions are designed
to address these challenges effectively, providing farmers with accurate data and actionable
insights. Through the use of drones, our technology allows for precise and timely monitoring of
crops, detecting early signs of pest infestation or nutrient deficiencies. This enables farmers to
take prompt action, preventing potential crop damage and improving overall yield.

Furthermore, Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd takes pride in offering comprehensive
services and support to our clients. We believe that establishing long-term partnerships built on
trust and reliability is crucial to our success. Our team works closely with farmers and businesses
to understand their unique requirements and tailor solutions that fit their needs perfectly. From
initial consultation and system design to installation, training, and ongoing support, we are
dedicated to providing a seamless experience throughout the entire process.

When it comes to agricultural technology, it is essential to choose a company that prioritizes
sustainability and environmental responsibility. Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd is
committed to developing solutions that not only enhance productivity but also minimize the
environmental impact. By utilizing drones for targeted applications such as precision spraying or
exact nutrient allocation, we help reduce the usage of chemicals and fertilizers, promoting
sustainable farming practices.

In addition to our extensive experience and commitment to innovation, Aolan Drone Science and
Technology Co., Ltd offers competitive pricing and flexible solutions. We understand the varying
needs and budgets of farmers and businesses, and thus, our range of products and services cater to
different scales of operations. Whether you are a small-scale farmer or own a large agricultural
enterprise, we have the right solutions to meet your requirements without compromising on quality.

In conclusion, with Aolan Drone Science and Technology Co., Ltd, you can expect exceptional
innovation, quality, and customer support. Our extensive experience and expertise in agricultural
technology make us the ideal partner for farmers and businesses looking to enhance productivity and
efficiency. By choosing us, you are selecting a company that not only understands your unique
challenges but also offers tailored solutions that deliver tangible results. Trust Aolan Drone
Science and Technology Co., Ltd to take your farming operations to new heights.

Smarter Precision in Every World

** Empower your daily operations with our advanced GNSS, precision positioning, mapping, and
navigation solutions. **
[HOME_BUTTON][47]
* ## GEOSPATIAL
  
  CHC Navigation is a leader in the geospatial industry, delivering advanced geospatial technology
  that transforms mapping and surveying. Our geospatial solutions integrate GNSS, LiDAR, UAV, and
  USV systems to achieve high-precision results. Designed for professionals, CHC Navigation empowers
  smarter decisions and sustainable development through geospatial innovation.
  
  [ Go to Geospatial ][48]
* ## MACHINE CONTROL
  
  CHC Navigation delivers advanced machine control solutions that improve precision, productivity,
  and efficiency in earthmoving. Our GPS machine control systems for excavators, dozers, graders,
  and compactors are complemented by GNSS rovers and CAD field software empowering your jobsite to
  stay on schedule and within spec.
  
  [ Go to Machine Control ][49]
* ## NAVIGATION
  
  We lead innovation in GNSS navigation with hybrid GNSS+INS technologies built for unmanned
  systems, robotics, and autonomous vehicles. CHC Navigation GPS RTK sensors and chipsets enable
  high-accuracy, reliable performance for integrators in automotive, logistics, mining, and
  construction, powering scalable autonomous navigation applications.
  
  [ Go to Navigation ][50]
* ## AGRICULTURE
  
  Improve your precision agriculture practices with smart agriculture solutions built for farms of
  any size. CHC Navigation’s tractor guidance and auto-steering systems, powered by GPS farming
  technologies, optimize planting, irrigation, and harvesting, helping you increase yields, cut
  costs, and drive sustainability across every stage.
  
  [ Go to Agriculture ][51]

## EXPLORE OUR SOLUTIONS

## Innovating Global Positioning, Navigation & Mapping Solutions

CHC Navigation advances precise positioning, mapping, and navigation technologies for professionals
worldwide. Our solutions improve efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility across geospatial
surveying, digital construction, precision agriculture, and autonomous navigation applications.
Through innovation and global support, CHC Navigation helps organizations turn reliable location
intelligence into better field operations and smarter decision-making.

### Rural futures in a complex world

Rural futures sit at the nexus of contemporary global challenges. Some of the challenges facing
rural areas in the 21st century include climate change, migration, ageing, depopulation,
technological innovations and urbanisation. Significantly, not all rural areas are alike: some lie
close to urban centres and are embedded within a wider hinterland, while others are extremely
remote, often struggling to survive.

### Rural futures in a complex world

Rural futures sit at the nexus of contemporary global challenges. Some of the challenges facing
rural areas in the 21st century include climate change, migration, ageing, depopulation,
technological innovations and urbanisation. Significantly, not all rural areas are alike: some lie
close to urban centres and are embedded within a wider hinterland, while others are extremely
remote, often struggling to survive.

The Privacy Statement is about how this website collects and uses visitor information. The statement
contains information that you are entitled to when collecting information from our website, and
general information about how we treat personal data. The legal owner of the website is the

sharing and tip services. The treatment basis is the consent of the individual, unless otherwise
specified.

movements. Examples of what the statistics give us answers to are; how many people visit different
pages, how long the visit lasts, what websites users come from and what browsers are used. None of
the cookies allow us to link information about your use of the site to you as an individual. The
information collected by Google Analytics is stored on Google servers in the U.S.. The information
received is subject to the [Google Privacy Policy][36]. An IP address is defined as a personal
information because it can be traced back to a particular hardware and thus to an individual. We use
Google Analytics's tracking code to [anonymize the IP address][37] before the information is stored
and processed by Google. Thus, the stored IP address can not be used to identify the individual
user.

### **2. Search**

If the webpage has search function, it stores information about what keywords users use in Google
Analytics. The purpose of the storage is to improve our information service. The search usage
pattern is stored in aggregate form. Only the keyword is saved and they can not be linked to other
information about the users, such as the IP addresses.

#### THE WORLD’S MOST FLEXIBLE LEVELING SYSTEM FOR ROAD CONSTRUCTION

The worldwide known MOBA-matic is the best-selling grade and slope control system in road
construction. After a one-time calibration, the system takes over the control of the asphalt paver
screed fully automatically and immediately. In combination with the Big Sonic Ski, you achieve
maximum smoothness in the paving process. The simple and intuitive operation, as well as the high
reliability are further aspects that have made our MOBA-matic so successful – there’ s a reason why

[ View More ][75]

#### AUTOMATIC GRADE CONTROL

Set the altitude setpoint and switch on the automatic mode. The Big Sonic Ski measures the actual
value with its 4 sensors and the MOBA-Matic regulates the screed to the desired set value fully
automatically.

### ERGONOMIC & FUNCTIONAL DESIGN

The 4-button design allows an incredibly intuitive and efficient operation of the MOBA-Matic II. The
backlit keys also make night work possible. The unique housing design is also functional according
to the motto "form follows function" and therefore allows a very good grip.

### FLEXIBLE
### APPLICATIONS

Thanks to its compatibility with the largest number of sensors available on the market, the
MOBA-Matic II can be used on the paver for a wide variety of applications. The reference can be made
by laser, string, non-contact or 3D.

### MANUFACTURER-INDEPENDENT

As a manufacturer-independent Hang-On System, the MOBA-Matic II, together with the Big Ski, can be
installed on any paver in the world, regardless of age. This also applies to the Cross-Control
function, i.e. control of both screed sides via one MOBA-Matic II.

viticulture production consulting, soil fertility, and irrigation management on the California
Central Coast. We are also one of the leading providers of governmental compliance consulting

equipment.

At Precision Ag, we are dedicated to providing top-quality agriculture-related products and

# **EVERY VEHICLE. ON EVERY FARM. CONNECTED.**

Our software seamlessly connects your fertiliser and chemical ordering systems to your rural
partners & industry-leading machinery platforms, to make spreading and spraying smarter and more
efficient.

[ For farmers ][68]
[ For Contractors ][69]

#### In farming, what you put in determines what you get out.

#### Spreading and spraying aren’t just routine tasks—they play a big part in driving yield,
#### efficiency, and sustainability. Get them right and they can maximise results. Get them wrong
#### and they waste inputs, time and potential.

#### Precision Farming ensures every application counts.

[ GET IN TOUCH ][70]

## **WORKS WITH THE GEAR**** YOU’VE ALREADY GOT**

Our Precision Farming software seamlessly connects MyBallance, Hawkeye and other fertiliser
providers directly to industry-leading machinery platforms like John Deere, Trimble, Topcon and
Tirotech insuring the data flows seamlessly to and from your tractors, spreaders, sprayers and
guidance systems.

[Works with your gear]
[No paperwork]

## **NOBODY’S IN IT FOR
## ****THE PAPERWORK**

Whether you are a farmer or contractor, Precision Farming takes the hassle out of job tracking,
proof-of-placement and compliance reporting. Cutting out the paperwork and delivering the right
data, in the right place, at the right time.

## **TECHNOLOGY****
## THAT JUST WORKS**

It’s simple, intuitive, and designed for the way farmers and contractors work. No tech headaches, no
unnecessary complexity, just tools that make the job easier.

[Tech that works]

### “I switched to Precision from an old system that was getting expensive to keep working. I wanted
### something I could just push a button and get all the records I needed for reporting and the
### plans we need to have. Spreadify is simple, I just use it on my ipad and it’s made our spread
### and spray process so much more efficient”

**Hamish Molloy** 
Cairnbrae Dairies - Spreadify User

#### **FOR FARMERS**

Take advantage of all our features to make your farms environmental data management simple.

[ Learn more ][71]

#### **FOR CONTRACTORS**

Take advantage of all our features to streamline job management and reporting with farmers.

[ Learn more ][72]

## **TECHNOLOGY ADVICE****
## MADE EASY**

With so many options out there, choosing the best technology can be overwhelming.
Our **FREE Farmers Guide** helps you assess, select, and implement the right solutions—saving you
time, money while improving efficiency.

[ LEARN MORE ][73]

## ** OUR DATA PARTNERS**

[ PARTNER WITH US ][74]

## **LET’S TALK**

For hassle free job management, easy compliance and seamless data management get in touch with us
today.

Повышение эффективности молочного животноводства

**«Умная ферма»** – инновационный проект ГК «ЭФКО», призванный повысить эффективность
сельскохозяйственного бизнеса за счет современных технологий и комплексного подхода в кормлении
животных. Проект объединяет несколько ключевых направлений: **Лабораторию эффективных кормов**,

специализированных завода по производству защищенных жиров и белков**. Все подразделения работают на
достижение общей цели – повышение стандартов эффективности в животноводстве.

## F.A.Q.

##### Here Are Some Common Questions Customers Ask About SRIZFLY Drone Simulator

How to download and activate the SRIZFLY software?
:To download and activate our software, here’s what you need to know:
For the Free Trial Version
Simply fill out the Download form when you click download or free trial use.
Once downloaded, you can install and use the trial version directly – no activation is required.
 
For the Full Version
Purchase the full-featured version plan on our website. After completing your order, the download
link will be displayed on your order page and your email notification.

You will also receive an email with the activation code for your software.

Enter the activation code after installation to unlock the full version and use it for the
corresponding duration.

Which remote controllers are compatible with the simulator? Are specific cables or adapters
required?
SRIZFLY is compatible with a wide range of remote controllers, including (but not limited to):
* DJI: RC-N1, RC-N2, RC-N3, RC-Plus
* FUTABA: T6K V3S, T10J, T14SG
* Flysky: FS-I6S, FS-ST8
* TARANIS: X9D Plus, SM001
* Spektrum: Interlink DX
* Gaming Controllers: XBOX Series X, and more

## ABOUT US

Truemist Misting and Fogging System offers innovative, high-performance mist cooling and misting
systems for industrial, commercial, and residential applications. As a leading manufacturer of
misting systems in India, We have in-house manufacturing capabilities to manufacture nozzles and
other associated accessories.

Truemist Misting and Fogging System operates from Chennai and supplies through our India to
customers in cities including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, Gurgaon, Delhi region, and
Tinsukia (Assam). We work along with Industrial ventilation system manufacturers and offer a wide
range of mist system configurations to satisfy customer requirements.

In addition to regular misting accessories, we also offer integration of misting controls with
industrial building ventilation system and industrial roof ventilation system and helps our customer
manage their misting system remotely using automatic ON OFF timers, Sensor-based system activation,
and Remote monitoring and other control options with temperature and humidity controllers.

As processed RO water is required for mist spray system operations,  We help integrate the rainwater
harvesting system to reduce the operational cost. It helps saving water as well as other associated
costs in maintaining the regular RO water system.

May 23, 2024

Pet brands that focus on sustainability have grown 7.1 times faster than their conventional
counterparts in the last five years. This insight comes from our latest episode of the AgFuture
podcast. This week, we are joined by Jim Lamancusa, Executive Director of the Pet Sustainability
Coalition (PSC); Hannah Tirrell-Wysocki, Accreditation Manager at the PSC; and Kami Grandeen,
Alltech’s North American Companion Animal Sales Manager. They discuss the mission and growth of the
PSC, Alltech's recent reaccreditation with the PSC, and the platinum, gold, and silver
sustainability medals from EcoVadis, an organization that provides business sustainability ratings.
They also explore the shifting demand for sustainable pet foods by Millennials and Gen Z. Tune in to
learn how these initiatives are transforming the pet industry.

### [#245: How Neutral Foods is transforming dairy farming for a greener future through carbon
### neutrality | Jake Schmitz][11]

May 14, 2024

May 14, 2024

20 min

Neutral Foods was the first U.S. company to be certified as carbon neutral. In this enlightening
episode of Ag Future, we talk with Jake Schmitz, carbon reduction manager at Neutral, about
developing a carbon-neutral company. An organic dairy expert and advocate for sustainable farming
practices, Jake offers expert insights into the opportunities for dairy farmers to not only meet
their sustainability goals but to improve performance and profitability. Jake shares insights on
various Neutral projects aimed at reducing greenhouse gases, including interior fermentation, manure
management, and transitioning to electric power. He also discusses the use of Agolin®, a
Carbon-Trust-certified essential oil blend added to cow feed. Despite the challenges, Jake remains
hopeful about the future of farming and the role of companies like Neutral in driving sustainable
change.

* ## GEOSPATIAL
  
  CHC Navigation is a leader in the geospatial industry, delivering advanced geospatial technology

* ## MACHINE CONTROL
  
  CHC Navigation delivers advanced machine control solutions that improve precision, productivity,
  and efficiency in earthmoving. Our GPS machine control systems for excavators, dozers, graders,
  and compactors are complemented by GNSS rovers and CAD field software empowering your jobsite to
  stay on schedule and within spec.
  
  [ Go to Machine Control ][49]
* ## NAVIGATION
  
  We lead innovation in GNSS navigation with hybrid GNSS+INS technologies built for unmanned
  systems, robotics, and autonomous vehicles. CHC Navigation GPS RTK sensors and chipsets enable
  high-accuracy, reliable performance for integrators in automotive, logistics, mining, and
  construction, powering scalable autonomous navigation applications.
  
  [ Go to Navigation ][50]
* ## AGRICULTURE
  
  Improve your precision agriculture practices with smart agriculture solutions built for farms of
  any size. CHC Navigation’s tractor guidance and auto-steering systems, powered by GPS farming
  technologies, optimize planting, irrigation, and harvesting, helping you increase yields, cut
  costs, and drive sustainability across every stage.
  
  [ Go to Agriculture ][51]

## Endona Corporation Sdn Bhd

Endona advances modern agriculture through innovation, farmer capability development and connected
ecosystems. By delivering technology solutions, practical training and strategic partnerships, it
strengthens productivity across the farming value chain while promoting sustainable practices that
balance profitability, responsibility and long-term resilience.

Endona brings over two decades of professional project experience, supported by growing capital and
regional expansion, delivering reliable results with a strong proven track record.

[Learn More >][18]

Our integrated business scope covers Contract Management, Agricultural Processing, and Intelligent
Technology, aligning with our mission and vision to Inspire Improvement Through Innovation.

[Learn More >][19]

## Performance milestone

Endona began as Geomatika Detection Sdn Bhd before being renamed Endona Corporation Sdn Bhd in 2005,

## Endona Corporation Sdn Bhd

Endona advances modern agriculture through innovation, farmer capability development and connected
ecosystems. By delivering technology solutions, practical training and strategic partnerships, it
strengthens productivity across the farming value chain while promoting sustainable practices that
balance profitability, responsibility and long-term resilience.

Rural futures sit at the nexus of contemporary global challenges. Some of the challenges facing
rural areas in the 21st century include climate change, migration, ageing, depopulation,
technological innovations and urbanisation. Significantly, not all rural areas are alike: some lie
close to urban centres and are embedded within a wider hinterland, while others are extremely
remote, often struggling to survive.

### **Privacy Policy**

The Privacy Statement is about how this website collects and uses visitor information. The statement
contains information that you are entitled to when collecting information from our website, and
general information about how we treat personal data. The legal owner of the website is the
processing officer for the processing of personal data. It is voluntary for those who visit the web
sites to provide personal information regarding services such as receiving newsletters and using the
sharing and tip services. The treatment basis is the consent of the individual, unless otherwise
specified.

### **1. Web analytics and cookies (cookies)**

As an important part of the effort to create a user-friendly website, we look at the user pattern of
those who visit the site. To analyze the information, we use the [Google Analytics][35] analysis
tool. Google Analytics uses cookies (small text files that the site stores on the user's computer),
which registers the users' IP address and provides information about the individual user's online
movements. Examples of what the statistics give us answers to are; how many people visit different
pages, how long the visit lasts, what websites users come from and what browsers are used. None of
the cookies allow us to link information about your use of the site to you as an individual. The
information collected by Google Analytics is stored on Google servers in the U.S.. The information
received is subject to the [Google Privacy Policy][36]. An IP address is defined as a personal
information because it can be traced back to a particular hardware and thus to an individual. We use
Google Analytics's tracking code to [anonymize the IP address][37] before the information is stored
and processed by Google. Thus, the stored IP address can not be used to identify the individual
user.

### **2. Search**

If the webpage has search function, it stores information about what keywords users use in Google
Analytics. The purpose of the storage is to improve our information service. The search usage
pattern is stored in aggregate form. Only the keyword is saved and they can not be linked to other
information about the users, such as the IP addresses.

construction. After a one-time calibration, the system takes over the control of the asphalt paver
screed fully automatically and immediately. In combination with the Big Sonic Ski, you achieve
maximum smoothness in the paving process. The simple and intuitive operation, as well as the high

#### AUTOMATIC GRADE CONTROL

Set the altitude setpoint and switch on the automatic mode. The Big Sonic Ski measures the actual
value with its 4 sensors and the MOBA-Matic regulates the screed to the desired set value fully
automatically.

### ERGONOMIC & FUNCTIONAL DESIGN

The 4-button design allows an incredibly intuitive and efficient operation of the MOBA-Matic II. The
backlit keys also make night work possible. The unique housing design is also functional according
to the motto "form follows function" and therefore allows a very good grip.

### FLEXIBLE
### APPLICATIONS

Thanks to its compatibility with the largest number of sensors available on the market, the
MOBA-Matic II can be used on the paver for a wide variety of applications. The reference can be made
by laser, string, non-contact or 3D.

### MANUFACTURER-INDEPENDENT

As a manufacturer-independent Hang-On System, the MOBA-Matic II, together with the Big Ski, can be
installed on any paver in the world, regardless of age. This also applies to the Cross-Control
function, i.e. control of both screed sides via one MOBA-Matic II.

## 

Precision Planting, LLC is the leading provider of practical and effective precision ag technologies
to help make farmers smarter every season.

 

The benefits of the Soil-Max products have worldwide reach, revolutionizing surface drainage and
land improvement management around the globe. They produce consistent and quality results on all
soil types, making them invaluable tools for any farmer.

There is also those fields you can't make it to with a sprayer, or patches of weed, insect, or
disease damage. Fly in with a drone to spot spray or cover the whole field. 



Dakota Micro takes great pride in producing rear view and surveillance products, including the Ag
Cam, OverView and EnduraCam product lines that exhibit unsurpassed quality that ride the
cutting-edge of advanced camera technology. This, combined with the highest level of customer
service, makes Dakota Micro the best choice for all of your rearview camera and observation needs.



[AgCam]

Ag Leader Technology is a leading manufacturer of precision ag displays and hardware, providing
products and services that range from auto-steer systems, yield monitors, planter and sprayer
controls, and data management software.

Harvest International, Inc. is a leader in manufacturing planting equipment featuring modular
customization designed to integrate with the latest precision planting technology. By listening to
our customers, we strive to develop innovative solutions in design and materials to bring value to
advanced farming operations across the world.

"The liquid control advantage in agriculture".

SurePoint Electronics was founded with the goal to bring high-quality electronics products into the
precision ag market.

## Support is Key

 Getting started with precision ag equipment can be a daunting task. We do not believe in downtime.
Not only is it frustrating, but it can be very costly. That's why we provide our customers with 24/7
service. 

We provide the very latest in aftermarket Precision Ag products and services to help you become
progressively more profitable. Our offerings include soil sampling services, field tile design, tile
planning, variable rate planting and fertility recommendations, drones for ag, agcam cameras, auto
steer systems, yield monitors, planter controls, tile plows, and comprehensive Data Management. We
are passionate about both technology and agriculture and are deeply committed to showing
forward-looking farmers exciting new ways of doing things.

# TODAY’S FARMING GROUNDED
# IN SCIENCE

Precision Ag Consulting is an agricultural consulting company specializing in vineyard management,
viticulture production consulting, soil fertility, and irrigation management on the California
Central Coast. We are also one of the leading providers of governmental compliance consulting
regarding the Irrigated Lands Program of the Central Coast Regional Water Quality Control Board.
Additionally, we sell and service the Davis line of weather stations and soil moisture monitoring
equipment.

At Precision Ag, we are dedicated to providing top-quality agriculture-related products and
services. We use the latest technology and techniques to help growers, agricultural consultants, and
farm managers achieve maximum success through improved crop quality and plant growth and development
while saving time and money.

## Since 2001

The Trail Survey group of companies has been a prominent participant in the Southern African
geomatics sector since 2001. As a versatile surveying service provider, we have successfully
completed over 3,500 diverse survey projects. These projects span various sectors, including
Engineering, Mining, Agriculture, Cadastral, Architecture, and Security (Forensic). Since our
inception, we’ve leveraged our global expertise while maintaining a strong local presence and a
shared history.

Our unwavering commitment to fostering excellent client relationships remains at the core of our
values. It brings us great pride to reveal that over 40% of our client base consists of returning
clients, some of whom have been with us since our establishment in 2001. Our dedicated team shares a
passion for service excellence, ensuring unparalleled customer satisfaction.

At the heart of society, our mission as a geomatics service provider for urban and regional
infrastructure propels us to contribute to the welfare of communities, integrating projects and
worksites to stimulate social and economic development.

Our extensive knowledge and expertise in South Africa empower us to deliver comprehensive geomatics
solutions, emphasizing quality, reliability, and safety. Our flexible and responsive organizational
structure, backed by empowered management and autonomous operational units, allows us to
consistently adapt and allocate the necessary human and technical resources.

We offer tailored solutions that align with your budget and project requirements.
